Architecture, hardware & evidence

Nextcloud Deployment

4 running at captureCompose project: nextcloud · Up ~7 days · PostgreSQL healthy

Inspect deployment capture ↗
Technical notes
  • Separate containers keep the application, PostgreSQL, Redis and scheduled jobs independently manageable.
  • Volumes or bind mounts preserve data beyond a container's lifecycle. Deleting that storage can still lose data; the database retains its own persistent records.
  • Cron uses shared application configuration and data so jobs can run without web traffic.
  • Compose groups service definitions and dependencies for inspection, logs and explicit restarts over SSH.
  • Tailscale Serve forwards HTTPS to the local loopback service on port 8080. Redis caching and locking settings, mount paths and backup procedures are not established by the capture.

Nextcloud background-job documentation

Network & Access

Access & security notes
  • Devices must be authorized and connected. Nextcloud and SSH authentication, updates, device security and access controls remain necessary; private networking does not secure the whole host.
  • SSH over the tailnet is the administration route. This does not imply that Tailscale SSH is enabled.
  • The home network connects through a Bell router. Device identifiers, real addresses, credentials and tunnel endpoints are omitted.

Tailscale Serve documentation
